Enumerates info from Windows and Samba systemsEnum4linux is a tool for enumerating information from Windows and Samba
systems. It attempts to offer similar functionality to enum.exe formerly
available fromwww.bindview.com.
It is written in PERL and is basically a wrapper around the Samba tools
smbclient, rpclient, net and nmblookup. The samba package is therefore a
dependency.
Installed size:58 KBHow to install:sudo apt install enum4linux
Updated on: 2025-Dec-09
usage_examples: Simple wrapper around the tools in the samba package to provide similar
-l        Get some (limited) info via LDAP 389/TCP (for DCs only)
Used to get sid with "lookupsid known_username"
This option is enabled if you don't provide any other options.
-k user   User(s) that exists on remote system (default: administrator,guest,krbtgt,domain admins,root,bin,none)
NB: Samba servers often seem to have RIDs in the range 3000-3050.
-v        Verbose.  Shows full commands being run (net, rpcclient, etc.)
